title: Strategy yield computation trusts external balance reads (flash-loan donation)
justification: Value leak with stated assumptions per C4 Medium. yield = totalBalance - principal trusts external strategy balance reads. If a strategy's reported balance is inflatable via flash-loan donation, an attacker drains real reserves at the discount rate. Strategy-side root cause is OOS, but SYA's lack of any defensive bound (per-claim cap, TWAP) is the in-scope SYA-layer gap per user guidance. Medium because exploitation requires a donation-inflatable strategy interface (stated assumption) and discount delta is bounded.
preconditions: Registered strategy reports balance via balance-based accounting susceptible to donation; attacker has flash-loan capital.
impact: Real reserves drained at the discount rate; phlimbo accounting takes the loss.
attack_path_summary: 1) Attacker flash-loans reward asset. 2) Donates to inflatable strategy, inflating totalBalance. 3) Calls claim with NFT to capture inflated yield at discount. 4) Repays flash loan; profit = donation * discount.
